theorem_title: Exact logarithmic certificate for four switch coefficients
natural_language_statement: The real natural logarithm of 2 lies between 0.693147180559945 and 0.693147180559946. The four exact rational quartic coefficients obey their respective derivative-series bounds: a1 log(2)<log(231), 2 a2 log(2)<=1+1/231, 3 a3 log(2)<=(1-1/231^2)/2, and 4 a4 log(2)<=(1+1/231^3)/3. These are unconditional exact real inequalities.
